decisions.reason: As a standard construction dumper facing strong competition from established suppliers, its results likely fall short of the firm's aspirations, triggering search for alternative uses of resources.
This specialized inclined furniture lift line aligns with the firm's engineering and safety strengths, so its performance is likely near or above aspirations despite limited market size.
The inclined building material lift serves construction needs and likely meets aspirations, while sharing resources with D lowers uncertainty.
Although the truck-mounted variant remains more uncertain, organisational slack and its technological overlap with D and E make carrying it acceptable.
